notes: B4 and B7 — the money, both directions. Second pass adds the half I missed: the money coming BACK from a sale, the brand's share of it, and his withdrawal.
the_headline_finding: ⚠️ EVERYTHING ON THESE SCREENS HAS NEVER RUN ONCE. escrow_entries 0 rows · wallet_transactions 0 rows · influencer_withdrawals 0 rows · every brand wallet ₹0 · all 25 creator wallets ₹0 withdrawable and ₹0 pending. The code is there — three tranches, escrow fees, TDS, payouts — and not one rupee has moved through it. The first real payment will be the first test any of it has had.
the_two_aims_are_paid_differently: Pay for content: his money is LOCKED IN ESCROW at publish, released 25% on contract signed, 25% on content live, 50% after the admin-set wait (trigger_event: contract_signed / content_live / day_30_post_live). He pays whether or not anything sells. Pay per sale: NOTHING is locked and nothing is owed — a follower buys, commission credits her PENDING balance, and it becomes withdrawable after the 30-day return window. He pays out of a sale that already happened. The screens must never blur the two.
three_new_screens_one_omission: All three are the same fault: the money is built and nobody can see it or reach it. (1) Inside escrow — the wallet shows a locked total with no way to find out what it is for. (2) Her tranche timeline — she cannot see hers; the words 'Tranche Timeline' exist on the COMMISSION screen, for an aim that has no tranches, while the aim that does has no screen. (3) WITHDRAW — there is no withdraw screen at all, though the endpoint, the ₹100 minimum and the 10% TDS are written and waiting.
her_pending_is_one_number_covering_three: A return window and two dated tranches are three different things. Lumped together they make her think she is owed money nobody plans to send. Broken out by why, each with its date.
tds_gets_a_sentence: 'TDS is a tax deduction, not a fee. You claim it back with Form 16A.' A creator watching 10% disappear needs telling once.
her_profile_gains_one_thing: A default shipping address, so the remote-shoot screen has something to offer instead of an empty form. NOT 'where you will work' — that is a per-deal answer and lives on the pitch.

release.deploy_class: deploy-inert — mockups and specification only, no code

the_half_i_missed.founder: "you handled one side that is pay for content one, what about pay commission and sale one...this gives money to brand..after platform and creator commission and all...here admin decide commission based on industry (it already exists)...withdrawal request from brands need for the money available in wallet......this piece is missing"
the_half_i_missed.what_it_is: A sale sends money TO the platform, which splits three ways: her commission, our fee, and what the brand keeps. The brand then has to be able to withdraw his share. I had drawn only money going IN.
the_half_i_missed.two_wallets_one_screen: A brand wallet has two halves that must NEVER be added together. CAMPAIGN MONEY is what he put in to pay creators (top-up, escrow, tranches out). SALES MONEY is what he earned and can take out. One number covering both would be meaningless.

the_shape_was_designed: follower_transactions already carries gross_amount, discount_amount, net_amount, influencer_commission, marketplace_fee_amount, brand_net, brand_settlement_status, brand_settled_at, commission_reversed and brand_net_reversed. brand_withdrawals exists as a table — status, failure_reason, razorpay_payout_id — with an admin approval path in admin.controller. 0 rows, no screen anywhere. The shape was designed; the arithmetic was never written and no surface was ever built.

correction_i_owed_him.what_i_said: That on 16 real sales two of the three shares were never computed — marketplace_fee_amount 0/16, brand_net 0/16 — and called it a live bug.
correction_i_owed_him.what_is_true: Those 16 sales are SEEDED PRACTICE DATA. Zero of them carry a razorpay_payment_id, all belong to one practice brand, and the rows were written straight into the table rather than through the app. The seed did not fill those two columns; the live code was never involved. The arithmetic IS written and is called from three places in transaction.controller. The narrower true statement: the fee model has never run on a real payment. Untested, not broken.
correction_i_owed_him.the_hazard_that_remains: The seeded nulls will make any screen built on this data render blanks, and anyone reading the table will reach the wrong conclusion — as I did. The seed should be corrected before these screens are built.

the_industry_commission_exists.correction: I also said the industry-based commission does not exist. It does, and it is better than what I described. The founder pointed me at it.
the_industry_commission_exists.the_table: categories — 16 industries, each with THREE rates by how the sale arrived. Path A a direct buy, Path B through a creator link, Path C attributed within 30 days.
the_industry_commission_exists.examples: Fashion 10/5/7 · packaged food, salon, travel 9/5/7 · restaurant, jewellery, furniture, gym 8/4/6 · florist, function hall, wedding 10/5/7. All with a 30-day return window, all active.
the_industry_commission_exists.the_idea: PATH B IS ALWAYS THE LOWEST. When a creator brought the customer she is already taking a cut, so the platform takes less — a sale the platform wins itself earns double. There is also a per-brand override, commerce_commission_override_pct, which beats the table.
the_industry_commission_exists.where_it_lives: backend/src/services/pricing.service.js computeL3OnFollowerTxn, admin screen at Packages/brand-web/app/admin/pricing/categories, 60s cache.

what_is_genuinely_missing: The brand's SALES-MONEY view — his share of what sold. No screen.
The brand's WITHDRAWAL screen. brand_withdrawals exists as a table with an admin approval path in admin.controller, 0 rows, no surface anywhere.
Her withdraw screen — same story on her side.
Inside-escrow, so a locked total can be explained.

three_paths_became_one.founder: "we changed the complete ecommerce architecture to a mix of ecommerce and shoppable posts like instagram posts...each post designed by creator so whatever sale happens is through post...brand, campaign, creator, posts and products all are connected so no concept of creator attribution in this architecture...path A is if in future our inflx platform can create posts for brands...for now only path B...no meaning for path C that is window and attribution"
three_paths_became_one.why: The three paths belonged to the OLD architecture — e-commerce with attribution, where a follower clicked a link, browsed and bought later, so you needed a window to decide whose sale it was. In the new architecture every sale happens INSIDE a shoppable post, and brand → campaign → creator → post → products is one chain. THE POST IS THE ATTRIBUTION.
three_paths_became_one.path_a: RESERVED, not deleted. When INFLX has enough organic traffic to make posts for brands itself, the rate is already there and already per-industry.
three_paths_became_one.path_b: THE ONLY LIVE PATH. A creator's post. Fashion 5%, restaurant 4%, salon 5%, and so on.
three_paths_became_one.path_c: RETIRED. It answered "she got the click, someone else got the sale" — a question this architecture cannot ask. The attribution_clicks lookup inside classifyPath becomes dead code for the fee.
three_paths_became_one.note: Channel-level link tracking (Stage 7, follower app) is a DIFFERENT thing and is not touched here.

return_window_is_now_7_days: Was 30. She sees a sale as pending, and 7 days later it moves into her wallet. Touches payment_config.return_window_days, categories.return_window_days on all 16 rows, and commission-confirm.job.js. NOT the same as tranche_3_release_after_days, which is the pay-for-content final payment and stays admin-set at 7/15/30.
return_window_settled: Founder, 2026-08-30: "yes shoppers return window...no 30 day...yes return window is 7 days...commission amount show to creator but not in wallet till return window completed." ONE WINDOW, 7 DAYS, FOR EVERYBODY. Her commission is SHOWN the moment the sale happens and enters her wallet only when the 7 days close — so money is never taken back out of it. commission_reversed and brand_net_reversed only ever touch pending money. That is exactly what pending_balance already is.
